_comment: Example. Copy into the repo and own it.
bkit install does not write this file and does not overwrite a copy.
Capability drift rules — the one hand-maintained input behind docs/capabilities.md.
Each rule is a literal marker for a capability's mechanism, plus the owner module every caller should use.
bkit-graph-drift.py derives status: no owner -> split; owner missing -> gap; owner present and other files match -> bypassed; else one.
Patterns are literal, never regex. A regex metacharacter in the marker matches nothing and reads as a clean result.
Optional scope: array of path prefixes. Optional surface: product (default), tests, or all.
Optional budgets: exact non-owner site count allowed per scope prefix. Measured == declared => budgeted.
Add a rule when a capability gets an owner. Statuses are computed, never typed in.
Replace the example rule. Do not leave it pointing at a file this repo does not have.

rules.note: Replace with a real mechanism marker and the one module every caller should use.
